notes: Full flattened values per locale in translations/<locale>.flat.json (dotted path -> value). Served JSON bodies (exact parsed body of GET /translations, real Rails request, NOTES_PATH=temp) in translations/served_<label>.json; en_fill_keys = served leaves absent from the locale's own config/locales YAML: filled from en by deep merge OR coming from Rails gem locale files (activemodel errors.messages.*, errors.format, errors.connection_refused...). Locale resolution order: ?locale= param > Config 'locale' (.fed > FRANKMD_LOCALE env > 'en'); invalid values keep previous I18n.locale (reset to en per request here). Interpolation vars are %{name} tokens.
